title: Growth notes & weekly check-ins (personal journal)
content:
Quick context: personal notes to track growth experiments, weekly check-in bullets, prep for 1:1s, and things I want to surface in calibration. Not polished — shorthand, TODOs, links to tickets.

This week (notes-to-self):
- Focus: new hire ramp improvements for Eng infra cohort (first 30 days). Identify top 3 blockers: lack of onboarding checklist, infra sandbox access delays, mentor pairing inconsistencies.
- Quick metric to track: median time-to-first-PR (target < 14 days). Current baseline: ~21 days (rough estimate). Need to pull real data from People Analytics + Eng onboarding ticket tags.
- Action: sync with Liza (eng manager) and DevEx next Tue. Bring checklist draft.

Personal growth goals (quarter):
- Q1: Lead 1 cross-functional onboarding revamp (deliverable: simple checklist + two pilot cohorts).
- Q2: Create a lightweight manager toolkit for early coaching checkpoints (15/30/60 prompts).
- Soft skill: Improve strategic storytelling — practice 5-min narrative for OKR updates.

Manager 1:1 prep (upcoming):
- Wins to share: piloted new onboarding survey, got 12 responses w/ 4 clear theme items. Small win: shortened doc access time by ~2 days in pilot.
- Risks to flag: headcount slack in Apr might delay mentor pairing. Ask: can we reallocate two mentors from infra -> cross-team for 6 weeks?
- Ask for manager: feedback on promotion readiness for two ICs (Avery, Jonah). Prepare examples of scope and outcomes.
- Career conversation prompt: what does senior P/O look like here? Request concrete examples, timelines.

Self-review snippets (for later paste into org form):
- Delivered: led pilot that reduced doc access friction; ran 2 feedback sessions and iterated checklist (outcome: clearer first-day tasks).
- Impact: Improved new hire confidence (n=12 survey). Anecdote: new hire wrote "I knew exactly who to ping on day 2" — use as qualitative evidence.
- Growth areas: data fluency (need to get comfortable pulling time-to-first-PR), stakeholder influence (work on framing asks to Eng leadership).

Open questions / parking lot:
- Need to confirm whether we can get granular access logs from SSO team (helpful for ramp metric). Jira ticket? HR-237 (linked).
- Compensation calibration timeline — is it shifting this cycle? Flag with People Ops lead.
- Should we run onboarding NPS quarterly or after each cohort? Tradeoffs: cadence vs noise.

Experiment backlog (short):
- A/B test two onboarding checklists (minimal vs comprehensive) — measure time-to-first-PR and self-reported confidence at 14 days.
- 15-min 1:1 templates for mentors — quick pulse template. Pilot w/ 4 mentors.
- Office hours drop-in for new hires (first 2 weeks) — trial 2x/week virtual sessions.

Micro-TODOs (near term):
- Draft checklist v0 (by Fri) — include access steps, first-week learning suggestions, codebase chart.
- Create survey follow-up (14-day short form) — ask 6 quick questions.
- Pull baseline metric: time-to-first-PR (ask People Analytics for query) — create HR-analytics ticket.

Notes to self (style + reminders):
- When framing asks to Eng leads: start with "what's the cost of not doing this?" then propose a lightweight mitigation.
- Save examples of senior behaviors in a folder for promotion evidence. One-liners > long paragraphs.
- Keep 1:1s goal-oriented. Always end with an explicit next step.

Random half-baked ideas:
- Buddy badge: small public recognition for mentors who complete onboarding checklist reviews. Might boost participation.
- Onboarding map: simple visual (1-pager) of first 90 days w/ owners + signals. Could be slide deck.

End. Will iterate this doc before self-review submission.

(Sign-off) maya — quick, messy, useful.
